messages.subject: Re: Live music — Jake Essex
messages.body:
Hi,

Quick bump on Jake Essex for South Benfleet Social Club. He's a proper 50s and 60s rock and roll singer (himself, not a tribute), own PA, no deposit. He performs locally and always becomes a talking point at social clubs.

Indicative fee is from £250 for two one hour sets. If a Saturday in the months ahead could work (or a Friday or Sunday), reply here and I'll send free dates, or pass me to the entertainment person.

If it's not for you, reply "no thanks" and I won't email again.

Natalie
Bookings for Jake Essex
www.jakeessex.co.uk

messages.subject: Re: Live music — Jake Essex

Following up on Jake Essex for Dunstable United Services Club. He sings the 50s and 60s properly (Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis and more), own PA, no deposit. Ex-servicemen's clubs are where he goes down best.
